art_direction: 雾灰蓝底玫瑰双眼，目光轻抬，带克制的翻眼感。
composition_variation: Create a subtle upward glance rather than a theatrical eye roll. Both large pupils shift upward together under gently raised upper arches, leaving more muted rose iris visible beneath them. Keep the viewer-left eye forty percent open and the right sixty percent open, with the right center slightly lower. The pupils must stay broad and attached visually to the lids; never add eye whites. The uneven openings and upward attention should suggest a quietly dismissive reaction, controlled and stylish.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
